content:
The 30th Anniversary year of the behemoth Pokémon franchise is almost over, but The Pokémon Company still has a few surprises in their card sleeves for us!

If you’re still on the hunt for sealed Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration stock without dropping hundreds of pounds (and I mean literally) on Night and Day UPCs or your fix of cardboard, Amazon currently has a rare restock worth keeping on your radar.

Snag That Eeevee Promo With This Amazon Deal

The Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Knock Out Collection, first released on September 16, 2026, is live now on Amazon US for £24.12, down 13% from its typical £27.61 listing price, plus £6.14 delivery to the UK with no import charges.

US buyers can also find listings for $31.84. For peace of mind, the current Amazon listing is sold and shipped directly by Amazon itself, ensuring a safe purchase and authentication for collectors. Unsurprisingly, the Knock Out Collection remains completely out of stock on both the Pokémon Centre UK and US storefronts, so this deal is bound to move quickly.

A Knock Out Collection is a great way to celebrate three decades of the franchise. If you’re looking to rip two 30th Anniversary Booster Packs, or snag a guaranteed promo without committing to a larger box, this could be worth adding to your collection. It's just a pretty budget-friendly option all round, so it's well worth picking up if you've got the opportunity.

I have to admit, I’m particularly excited that this is back in stock. I missed out back in September. Inside each collection, you get a foil promo card featuring Eevee. As IGN’s number one Eevee fan, a title I’ll defend with my life, this is definitely going in my basket.

Remember - each 30th Celebration Booster Pack includes five foil cards - including one of these awesome 30 Pikachu cards - and one foil Basic Energy card. And, who could forget the plastic Pokémon coin you get inside as well! Winner. Which is your favourite?

Now remember - before buying, it’s always worth doing a quick reality check on pricing. Knock Out Collections are traditionally budget-friendly impulse buys. This one retails for $9.99/£9.99. Even with Amazon's 13% discount, paying roughly £30 after shipping is still steep for a smaller collection.

That said, secondary market chaos is keeping 30th Celebration sealings hard to find at face value. Recent eBay and TCGPlayer sales have hovered around £35-£40 (plus shipping) for sealed Knock Out Collections, which means this listing from Amazon is, right now, one of the easiest, lowest-barrier ways to add an exclusive foil Eevee and two anniversary packs to your collection without battling silly, triple-digit reseller markups.

There's a whole bunch of awesome cards in the 30th Anniversary Booster Packs you can look forward to chasing down. To give you an idea of where the dust is settling, we’ve also recently pulled the median market prices per TCGplayer for the top 10 highest-value cards in the set, so you know what to look out for when ripping packs. But what I love about the 30th Anniversary set is the absolute bargains you can find, with some of the coolest cards I've ever seen. See below for my personal top picks, and good luck Trainers!

One thing’s for sure with this deal on Amazon - you’ll need to down your Carbos, slip on your Running Shoes, and move quick before this latest allocation of the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Knock Out Collection disappears again. But, once again, as with most of Amazon's recent restocks, the conpany will likely be restocking in short waves, so if you miss out on the most recent drop, make sure to add it to your wishlist and keep checking back in, as these are constantly reappearing at the moment.
